name: All 988 short names are unique, bounded and retain matching Gilded identities
Every card has new bilingual narrative and every chapter foreshadows the loop
A genuine v1.0.1 save resumes with its board, hand, deck and health intact
Card labels, search and details use the short names while identifiers remain stable
Generated identity labels stay compact while their saved IDs and personal names remain intact
Offering a Boss does not recruit it; choosing its reward recruits only that Boss
The loop cannot restart before the final chapter and claimed reward
The final return preserves companions, deck, reserve, collection and all replay unlocks
Loop progress survives reload and the next run begins in the first world with the saved party
The English journal and loop ending contain fully translated story text
Portrait and landscape phones keep story controls inside the viewport
Every chapter remains readable to its final paragraph on portrait and landscape phones in both languages
No browser errors during story and legacy-save scenarios
